purpose: Prove at runtime that every authoritative native still preserves scene-linear HDR values until the filmic display transform and explicitly terminates the Built-in image-effect chain in an sRGB LDR destination before PNG evidence is sealed.

displayTransform.singleDisplayEncodingStep: linear LDR fragment output -> sRGB RenderTexture write
forbiddenDefectMasking: local contrast used to hide material errors

failurePolicy.missingImageEffectTransformsToLDR: FAIL native review packet before capture
failurePolicy.anyStillWithoutHdrObservedSource: FAIL native review packet; highlight preservation is not proven for every still
failurePolicy.anyStillWithoutLinearHdrObservedSource: FAIL native review packet; the filmic transform may have received an incorrectly encoded source
failurePolicy.anyStillWithoutLdrObservedDestination: FAIL native review packet; HDR-to-LDR termination is not proven for every still
failurePolicy.anyStillWithoutSrgbLdrObservedDestinatio: FAIL native review packet; the single Linear-to-sRGB display write is not proven for every still
failurePolicy.missingTonemapInvocation: FAIL native review packet; do not seal or score stills
failurePolicy.fallbackInvocation: FAIL native review packet; do not seal or score stills

rationale: The benchmark uses physically plausible sunlight, specular response and a filmic shoulder, so clipping scene values before the display transform would invalidate lighting/material judgments even if the final PNG looks superficially acceptable.

A last-frame-only observation is insufficient. Each authoritative hero/oblique/grazing image-effect invocation contributes to explicit HDR, LDR, scene-linear-HDR and sRGB-LDR counters, and all four counters must equal the still count.

The source must remain linear while floating-point HDR and the destination must expose sRGB read/write when LDR, proving the intended single display-encoding step rather than merely proving buffer bit depth.
ImageEffectTransformsToLDR makes the intended transition explicit to Unity's Built-in image-effect pipeline instead of relying on an implicit destination format.

Runtime telemetry proves execution and transfer plumbing only. It cannot clear clipping, exposure, color, material, reflection or other visible defects without the actual 3840x2160 frames and 100% crops.

researchReferences.title: Unity 6 Built-in Render Pipeline HDR
researchReferences.use: Forward Built-in HDR requires a camera post-processing effect so the scene can render through an HDR buffer before display conversion.

researchReferences.title: Unity 6 RenderTexture.sRGB
researchReferences.use: Runtime read-only state used to prove that the observed HDR source is linear and the LDR destination owns the sRGB write transform.
